title.zh: 验尸官（部长证明书）条例 2023

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Coroners (Minister’s Certificate) Regulations 2023 and come into operation on 2 May 2023.

2.—(1) For the purpose of section 17A(1)(b) of the Act, a foreign State’s request for a Minister’s certificate to be issued must —
(a)be made by a diplomatic agent of the foreign State or a consular officer of the foreign State;
(b)be sent —
(i)by hand to the office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, 1 Sherwood Road, Tanglin, Singapore 248163; or
(ii)by email to mfa_duty_officer@mfa.gov.sg; and
(c)include the information mentioned in paragraph (2).
(2) The foreign State’s request must include —
(a)the deceased’s name, nationality and passport number or foreign identification number;
(b)the name, designation and contact details of the diplomatic agent or consular officer making the request;
(c)a statement of —
(i)which provision of section 17A(1)(a) of the Act the foreign State considers is applicable in respect of the deceased; and
(ii)the reasons for requesting the release of the deceased’s body; and
(d)any supporting document for the statement mentioned in sub‑paragraph (c).
